name: Beetroot Gnocchi with Garlic and Sage
subtitle: Tender beetroot gnocchi with wilted spinach and crisp aromatics
description: Roasted beetroot and potatoes form a soft, earthy gnocchi dough, served with garlic, sage, spinach, and grated cheese.

ingredients.item: plain wholemeal spelt flour plus extra for dusting
olive oil plus extra to serve (optional)
finely grated parmesan or vegetarian hard cheese

instructions.text: Preheat the oven. Roast the beetroot stems and baking potatoes until tender, about 60 minutes for the beetroot and 50 minutes for the potatoes.
When cool enough to handle, scoop the potatoes from their skins and mash them smoothly. Process the roasted beetroot stems until smooth.
Combine the beetroot and potato with the spelt flour. Knead briefly into a soft dough, adding only enough extra flour to prevent sticking.
Divide the dough into ropes, cut into gnocchi, and shape each piece as desired. Dust lightly with flour.
Warm the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced garlic and chopped sage, and cook until the garlic is crisp and the sage fragrant.
Stir the spinach into the skillet and cook until wilted. Keep the mixture warm.
Cook the gnocchi in boiling water for about 2 minutes, until they rise and are cooked through. Drain well.
Toss the gnocchi with the garlic, sage, and spinach. Add olive oil if desired and serve with the grated parmesan or vegetarian hard cheese.
